title: Standardized test scores and academic performance at a public university system
title_zh: 公立大学系统中标准化考试成绩与学业表现的关系
title_primary: 公立大学系统中标准化考试成绩与学业表现的关系
title_secondary: Standardized test scores and academic performance at a public university system
authors: Theodore Joyce, Mina Afrouzi, Sarah Truelsch, Kerstin Gentsch, Kyle Du
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Recent studies of Ivy-Plus institutions suggest that standardized test scores (SAT/ACT) are better predictors of college success than high school grade point average (HSGPA). In response, many elite colleges have re-instituted the requirement that test scores be submitted for admission. We ask whether re-establishing the SAT requirement for admission at a large urban public university system (hereafter the System) would improve the predictability of academic outcomes using administrative data for the 2010–2019 first-year cohorts. We also assess the use of a state-wide exam of English Language Arts (ELA) taken by students in their junior year of high school as a substitute for the SAT. Unobserved variables that determine who is admitted and where applicants matriculate can confound estimates of the effects of SAT and HSGPA on academic outcomes. While selection bias remains unavoidable, we estimate effects for subsamples of students whose choice of colleges outside the System, and campuses within the System, are likely limited. We also apply recent sensitivity tests that assess how strong a confounder would have to be to eliminate the effect of HSGPA or SAT on the outcomes. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in HSGPA is at least six times more predictive of six-year graduation than a comparable increase in SAT or the ELA. The estimated effect of HSGPA is robust to the inclusion of student characteristics, whereas the SAT and ELA are not. The adoption of a test-optional policy should not undermine the System’s ability to assess applicants’ potential for success in college.
abstract_zh: 近期针对常春藤联盟高校的研究表明，标准化考试成绩（SAT/ACT）比高中平均绩点（HSGPA）更能预测大学成功。对此，许多精英大学已重新要求提交考试成绩作为录取条件。我们探讨的是，在一个大型城市公立大学系统（以下简称“该系统”）中，重新设立SAT入学要求是否能提高学术成果的可预测性，利用2010至2019年新生队列的行政数据进行分析。同时，我们也评估了将高中三年级学生参加的州级英语语言艺术（ELA）考试作为SAT替代品的可行性。决定谁被录取以及申请者选择就读哪所大学的未观测变量，可能会混淆SAT和HSGPA对学术成果影响的估计。尽管选择偏差难以完全避免，我们针对那些选择该系统外大学及系统内校区可能性有限的子样本学生进行了效应估计。我们还应用了最新的敏感性测试，以评估一个混淆变量需有多强才能消除HSGPA或SAT对成果的影响。研究发现，HSGPA每增加一个标准差，对六年毕业率的预测能力至少是SAT或ELA同等增幅的六倍。HSGPA的估计效应在加入学生特征后依然稳健，而SAT和ELA则不然。采用考试可选政策不应削弱该系统评估申请者大学成功潜力的能力。

title: The Flight to Affordability: Effects of Pandemic Rent Increases on Renters By Geography
title_zh: 向可负担性的逃离：疫情租金上涨对不同地区租房者的影响
title_primary: 向可负担性的逃离：疫情租金上涨对不同地区租房者的影响
title_secondary: The Flight to Affordability: Effects of Pandemic Rent Increases on Renters By Geography
authors: Erin Troland, Isabella Agnes, Jessica Liu, Fatimah Shalaan, Michelle Tran 等
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In the pandemic era, people moved from high-density, expensive areas to more affordable areas, putting upward pressure on local housing prices. We examine the geographic distribution of rent growth during this time and its effects on renters. We use administrative new lease data from RealPage and household-level data on rent and income from the American Community Survey. We analyze rents and incomes using Public Use Microdata Areas grouped in two ways: by prepandemic rent levels and by pre-pandemic rent-to-income ratios. Rents grew more in areas with lower pre-pandemic rents but not in areas with lower rent-to-income ratios, consistent with higher-income remote workers moving away from high rent areas to more affordable areas. Lower-income households experienced larger increases in rent relative to their income compared to the median renter. However, area-level rent-to-income ratios reflect both compositional changes in renter populations from mobility and changes in local rents. We highlight the need for future work to track affordability for the same households over time to fully understand pandemic era affordability trends.
abstract_zh: 在疫情时代，人们从高密度、昂贵地区迁移至更为经济实惠的区域，对当地房价产生了上行压力。我们考察了这一时期租金增长的地理分布及其对租房者的影响。我们利用RealPage提供的行政新租赁数据以及美国社区调查中关于租金和收入的家庭层面数据，通过两种方式对公共使用微观数据区域进行分组分析：一是依据疫情前租金水平，二是依据疫情前租金收入比。结果显示，疫情前租金较低的地区租金增长更快，但租金收入比较低的地区并未出现此现象，这与高收入远程工作者从高租金地区向更可负担地区迁移的趋势相符。相较于中等收入租房者，低收入家庭经历了与其收入相比更大的租金涨幅。然而，区域层面的租金收入比既反映了因流动性导致的租房人口构成变化，也反映了当地租金的变动。我们强调，未来研究需追踪同一家庭随时间变化的负担能力，以全面理解疫情时代的负担能力趋势。

authors: Margherita Fort, Annalisa Loviglio, Susanna Tinti
official: 官方在线 2025-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the impact of a program designed to enhance data literacy on graduate students’ skills and academic outcomes in a large Italian university. The program (i.e. a minor) targets students who are expected to have weak quantitative competences and offers 120-hours training focused on improving the ability to interpret and process data, in addition to the regular courses of the master program in which students are enrolled (i.e. their major). The admission process to the minor is characterized by rationing, resolved by random assignment of available slots to applicants. Exploiting the resulting exogenous variation for identification, we find that the program largely improved digital literacy of participants with low pre-treatment levels of numeracy. Despite the additional effort required by the program, we can rule out any slowdown in the progress of the academic career in the major master program of participating students.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项旨在提升数据素养的项目对某大型意大利大学研究生技能及学业成果的影响。该项目（即辅修专业）针对预期定量能力较弱的学生，提供120小时的培训，重点提升其解读和处理数据的能力，同时不干扰学生所注册硕士主修专业的常规课程。辅修专业的录取过程存在名额限制，通过随机分配可用名额给申请者来解决。利用由此产生的外生变异进行识别，我们发现该项目显著提升了预处理阶段数值能力较低参与者的数字素养。尽管项目要求额外努力，我们可以排除参与学生在主修硕士项目中学业进展出现任何放缓的情况。

title: From prison peers to co-offenders
title_zh: 从狱友到共同犯罪者
title_primary: 从狱友到共同犯罪者
title_secondary: From prison peers to co-offenders
authors: Julian Vedeler Johnsen, Laura Khoury
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper provides direct evidence that shared incarceration can facilitate the formation of post-release criminal partnerships. Using Norwegian administrative data linking prison spells to police case identifiers, we measure network ties through subsequent co-offending. We exploit time-based variation in exposure within facilities by comparing inmate pairs in the same facility who differ only in whether their spells overlapped. Overlap is associated with a 37% increase in five-year co-offending relative to comparable non-overlapping pairs, robust to extensive controls and timing-based restrictions. Effects are stronger in environments and for pairs where interaction is plausibly more intense, highlighting network formation as a plausible mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了直接证据，表明共同监禁经历可能促进释放后犯罪伙伴关系的形成。利用挪威行政数据，将监狱服刑期与警方案件标识符相链接，我们通过后续共同犯罪来衡量网络联系。我们利用设施内接触时间上的变化，比较同一设施中仅在服刑期是否重叠上有所不同的囚犯配对。与可比的非重叠配对相比，重叠配对五年内共同犯罪率增加了37%，这一结果在广泛的控制变量和基于时间的限制条件下依然稳健。在互动强度可能更高的环境及配对中，效应更为显著，凸显了网络形成作为一种合理解释机制。

title: Impacts of Privatization on State-Owned Enterprises: A Tale of Zombie versus Healthy Firms
title_zh: 私有化对国有企业的影响：僵尸企业与健康企业之比较
title_primary: 私有化对国有企业的影响：僵尸企业与健康企业之比较

authors: Gang Xu, Ruiting Wang, Xue Wang, Tao Zha
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate the effects of privatization on zombie versus healthy state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in China, extending our analysis beyond TFP to a broad array of financial and economic indicators. Privatizing zombie SOEs generates persistent favorable effects: it enhances labor productivity and TFP, reduces bank subsidies, lowers leverage and administrative expenses, improves liquidity, boosts profits, and accelerates sales growth, thereby increasing their probability of recovery. Privatization’s effect on reducing government subsidies, however, is generally weaker and appears to be transient. These benefits are more pronounced than for healthy SOEs and display some heterogeneity across regions and industries. Our findings offer policy implications for emerging markets, suggesting that prioritizing the privatization of underperforming, zombie-like entities can be associated with substantial economic gains and efficiency improvements.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了私有化对中国僵尸与健康国有企业（SOEs）的影响，并将分析范围从全要素生产率（TFP）扩展至一系列广泛的金融与经济指标。私有化僵尸国有企业产生了持续积极的效果：它提升了劳动生产率与全要素生产率，减少了银行补贴，降低了杠杆率与行政开支，改善了流动性，增加了利润，并加速了销售增长，从而提高了其复苏的可能性。然而，私有化对减少政府补贴的影响普遍较弱，且似乎具有暂时性。这些益处相较于健康国有企业更为显著，并在不同地区和行业间展现出一定的异质性。我们的研究结果为新兴市场提供了政策启示，表明优先对表现不佳、类似僵尸的实体进行私有化，可带来显著的经济收益与效率提升。

title: When Inequality Matters for Macro and Macro Matters for Inequality
title_zh: 当不平等对宏观重要，宏观对不平等也重要时
title_primary: 当不平等对宏观重要，宏观对不平等也重要时

authors: SeHyoun Ahn, Greg Kaplan, Benjamin Moll, Thomas Winberry, Christian Wolf
official: 官方在线 2017-06-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop an efficient and easy-to-use computational method for solving a wide class of general equilibrium heterogeneous agent models with aggregate shocks, together with an open source suite of codes that implement our algorithms in an easy-to-use toolbox. Our method extends standard linearization techniques and is designed to work in cases when inequality matters for the dynamics of macroeconomic aggregates. We present two applications that analyze a two-asset incomplete markets model parameterized to match the distribution of income, wealth, and marginal propensities to consume. First, we show that our model is consistent with two key features of aggregate consumption dynamics that are difficult to match with representative agent models: (i) the sensitivity of aggregate consumption to predictable changes in aggregate income and (ii) the relative smoothness of aggregate consumption. Second, we extend the model to feature capital-skill complementarity and show how factor-specific productivity shocks shape dynamics of income and consumption inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种高效且易于使用的计算方法，用于求解一类广泛的具有总体冲击的一般均衡异质性主体模型，并附带一套开源代码套件，以易于使用的工具箱形式实现我们的算法。我们的方法扩展了标准线性化技术，旨在处理不平等对宏观经济总量动态产生影响的情形。我们展示了两个应用，分析了一个参数化以匹配收入、财富和边际消费倾向分布的两资产不完全市场模型。首先，我们证明我们的模型与代表性主体模型难以匹配的总体消费动态的两个关键特征一致：（i）总体消费对可预测的总体收入变化的敏感性，以及（ii）总体消费的相对平滑性。其次，我们将模型扩展至包含资本-技能互补性，并展示要素特定生产率冲击如何塑造收入和消费不平等动态。

title_primary: 州和地方关于芬太尼试纸的政策是否影响过量死亡？

authors: Endersby, Linnea, Harris, Matthew, Kessler, Lawrence
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the effects of legalizing fentanyl test strips (FTS), which identify the presence of fentanyl in recreational drugs, on overdose deaths. Using difference-in-differences methods, we find that purely increasing de jure access to fentanyl test strips (FTS), which can reduce information asymmetries regarding drug contents, had little effect on overdose mortality. We then examine the effects of multi-dimensional community-based interventions aimed at increasing de facto access to FTS and other harm reduction resources. These hands-on approaches were more effective in reducing overdose deaths. Together, these findings suggest that FTS are used at sub-optimal levels, and more active efforts to distribute them could reduce overdoses.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了将芬太尼试纸（FTS）合法化——这种试纸能识别娱乐性药物中芬太尼的存在——对过量致死的影响。采用双重差分方法，我们发现，仅从法律上增加芬太尼试纸的获取途径，虽能减少关于药物成分的信息不对称，但对过量死亡率影响甚微。随后，我们考察了旨在实际增加芬太尼试纸及其他减少伤害资源获取的多维度社区干预措施。这些实践性方法在降低过量死亡方面更为有效。综合来看，这些发现表明芬太尼试纸的使用未达最优水平，而更积极的推广分发努力或能减少过量事件。

title: The new grain giants: the reliability of USDA’s corn and soybean production forecasts for Brazil and Argentina
title_zh: 新粮食巨头：美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量预测的可靠性
title_primary: 新粮食巨头：美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量预测的可靠性

authors: Olga Isengildina Massa, Berna Karali, Scott H. Irwin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: While Brazil and Argentina emerged as major players in the world grain markets following a rapid expansion of corn and soybean production, little is known about their production forecasts. Our study demonstrates that the accuracy of USDA forecasts of Brazil and Argentina’s corn and soybean production varies drastically over the extended forecasting cycle. Specifically, early forecasts are not directionally consistent and offer limited statistical advantage to a naïve alternative. After 8–10 months into the forecasting cycle, these forecasts begin to provide meaningful information to market participants and become more accurate, efficient and reliable for the remainder of the forecasting cycle. These forecasts support export estimates in the US WASDE balance sheets as well as USDA baseline forecasts that have implications for federal budget outlays and may result in misallocation of resources when early projections are used.
abstract_zh: 尽管巴西和阿根廷在全球谷物市场中因玉米和大豆产量的迅速扩张而成为重要参与者，但对其生产预测的了解却十分有限。我们的研究表明，美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量的预测准确性在延长预测周期内波动剧烈。具体而言，早期预测在方向上并不一致，并且相对于一个简单的替代方案，其统计优势有限。在预测周期进入8至10个月后，这些预测开始为市场参与者提供有意义的信息，并在预测周期的剩余时间内变得更加准确、高效和可靠。这些预测支持了美国农业部WASDE平衡表中的出口估算以及基线预测，后者对联邦预算支出有影响，且当使用早期预测时可能导致资源配置不当。

authors: Robert Minton, Hugo Monnery
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using survey data from U.S. firms, we study the primitive beliefs for price-setting: firms’ forecasts of their own marginal costs. These forecasts are disconnected from CPI expectations, (over)react to current and past costs systematically, and underreact to aggregate shocks until costs move. We show that under empirically realistic cost beliefs the New Keynesian Phillips curve is steeper and less forward-looking. Supply shocks are more inflationary because they hit costs quickly. Demand shocks are less inflationary because firms fail to anticipate future wage pressure. Forward guidance weakens at long horizons but strengthens in the near term.
abstract_zh: 利用美国企业的调查数据，我们研究了价格设定中的原始信念：企业对其自身边际成本的预测。这些预测与CPI预期脱节，系统性地对当前及过去的成本作出（过度）反应，并且对总体冲击反应不足，直至成本变动发生。我们表明，在经验上现实可行的成本信念下，新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线更为陡峭且前瞻性较弱。供给冲击更具通胀效应，因为它们迅速影响成本。需求冲击的通胀效应较弱，因为企业未能预见到未来的工资压力。前瞻指引在长期内效果减弱，但在短期内则增强。

title: Role of environmental disclosure policy on access to finance: evidence from crowdfunding
title_zh: 环境信息披露政策对融资获取的作用：来自众筹的证据
title_primary: 环境信息披露政策对融资获取的作用：来自众筹的证据
title_secondary: Role of environmental disclosure policy on access to finance: evidence from crowdfunding
authors: John Jianqiu Bai, Yi Cao, Xiumin Martin, Chi Wan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the impact of an online market’s policy (environmental policy) offering entrepreneurs the option to disclose their environmental engagement on entrepreneurship outcomes, using Kickstarter as a laboratory. Following the policy’s implementation, 32.4% of entrepreneurs opted to disclose their environmental commitments. Using the passage of the environmental policy as an instrument, we show that environmental commitment improves funding outcomes, with the funding success rate increasing by 13.2% and the pledged funding ratio by 8.7%. Environmental commitment also attracts more environmentally conscious backers and brings in new backers, which likely contributes to these improved outcomes. However, environmental commitment does not have a material impact on the ultimate project success rate and significantly delays project delivery. Overall, the evidence suggests that Kickstarter’s nudge policy encourages entrepreneurs’ environmental engagement and helps them expand access to environmentally conscious backers by internalizing backers’ environmental preferences.
abstract_zh: 我们以Kickstarter为实验平台，研究在线市场的一项政策（环境政策）——即允许创业者选择披露其环保参与情况——对创业成果的影响。该政策实施后，32.4%的创业者选择披露其环保承诺。以该环境政策的实施作为工具变量，我们发现环保承诺改善了融资结果，融资成功率提高了13.2%，承诺融资比例提高了8.7%。环保承诺还吸引了更多具有环保意识的资助者，并带来了新的资助者，这很可能促进了上述改善。然而，环保承诺对最终项目成功率并无实质性影响，且显著延迟了项目交付。总体而言，证据表明Kickstarter的助推政策鼓励了创业者的环保参与，并通过内化资助者的环保偏好，帮助其扩大了对环保意识资助者的接触范围。

title: Offshore dollar funding shocks and the dollar exchange rate
title_zh: 离岸美元融资冲击与美元汇率
title_primary: 离岸美元融资冲击与美元汇率
title_secondary: Offshore dollar funding shocks and the dollar exchange rate
authors: Philippe Bacchetta, J. Scott Davis, Eric van Wincoop
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Deviations from covered interest rate parity (CIP) have persisted since the global financial crisis, reflecting a segmentation between onshore (US) and offshore dollar markets. This segmentation can give rise to dollar shortages in offshore markets during periods of financial stress. We propose a model with limited CIP and UIP arbitrage where the CIP deviation and exchange rate are jointly determined by equilibrium in the swap and spot FX markets. We consider offshore dollar funding shocks, where either the supply of dollar funding by the US to offshore markets declines or the demand for dollar funding in offshore markets rises. We show that this gives rise to dollar shortages, with a rise in the CIP deviation and appreciation of the dollar. In contrast to other models of exchange rate determination, the dollar appreciation is entirely due to imperfect CIP arbitrage.
abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，对利率平价（CIP）的偏离持续存在，反映了在岸（美国）与离岸美元市场之间的分割。这种分割在金融压力时期可能导致离岸市场出现美元短缺。我们提出了一个具有有限CIP和UIP套利的模型，其中CIP偏差和汇率由掉期市场和即期外汇市场的均衡共同决定。我们考虑了离岸美元融资冲击，即美国向离岸市场的美元融资供应减少或离岸市场对美元融资需求上升的情况。我们表明，这会导致美元短缺，伴随CIP偏差上升和美元升值。与其他汇率决定模型不同，这里的美元升值完全归因于不完全的CIP套利。

title: Structural Estimation with Unstructured Data
title_zh: 基于非结构化数据的结构估计
title_primary: 基于非结构化数据的结构估计
title_secondary: Structural Estimation with Unstructured Data
authors: Sara Casella, Jesús Fernández-Villaverde, Stephen Hansen, Ryohei Oishi, Minchul Shin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Standard macroeconomic data do not cleanly separate the systematic and non-systematic components of monetary policy. We show that incorporating unstructured text data into the structural estimation of a DSGE model can sharpen this distinction. We augment a standard state-space model with a non-core measurement block that links structural shocks to time series derived from FOMC transcripts, using a spike-and-slab prior to let the data select which series are informative. In a medium-scale New Keynesian model for the U.S., incorporating text improves predictive performance and materially alters structural inference: the new model estimates a lower response of the policy rate to inflation, higher price stickiness and lower price indexation, implying a flatter and less backward-looking price Phillips curve.
abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济数据无法清晰区分货币政策的系统性与非系统性成分。我们证明，将非结构化文本数据纳入DSGE模型的结构估计能够强化这一区分。我们通过一个非核心测量模块对标准状态空间模型进行扩展，该模块将结构性冲击与源自联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议记录的时序数据相关联，并采用尖峰-板状先验让数据自行选择具有信息量的序列。在美国中等规模新凯恩斯模型中，引入文本数据不仅提升了预测表现，还显著改变了结构性推断：新模型估计的政策利率对通胀的响应更低，价格粘性更高且价格指数化程度更低，这意味着更平坦且更少后顾性的价格菲利普斯曲线。

title: Can there be too much finance? A complex answer to a simple question
title_zh: 金融是否可能过度？一个简单问题的复杂答案
title_primary: 金融是否可能过度？一个简单问题的复杂答案
title_secondary: Can there be too much finance? A complex answer to a simple question
authors: Thorsten Beck
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides a critical review of the Too Much Finance literature, both in its academic contribution and as response to the earlier finance and growth literature. We describe the academic origins and development of the finance and growth literature and discuss pitfalls with the commonly used indicators of financial development. We explore how the finance and growth research findings can be translated into policy recommendations including with respect to the trade-off between growth and stability. Finally, we argue that the the question of ‘can there be too much finance’ contains actually three questions: can there be too much credit, can there be too large a financial sector, and can there be too much financial development.
abstract_zh: 本文对“过度金融化”文献进行了批判性评述，既探讨其学术贡献，也将其视为对早期金融与增长文献的回应。我们描述了金融与增长文献的学术起源与发展脉络，并讨论了常用金融发展指标存在的缺陷。我们探究了金融与增长的研究发现如何转化为政策建议，包括在增长与稳定之间的权衡问题。最后，我们认为“是否存在过度金融化”这一问题实际上包含三个子问题：是否存在过度信贷、是否存在过大的金融部门、以及是否存在过度的金融发展。

title: Upgrading the Global Financial Safety Net: Implications of a Synthetic Reserve Deposit
title_zh: 升级全球金融安全网：合成储备存款的影响
title_primary: 升级全球金融安全网：合成储备存款的影响
title_secondary: Upgrading the Global Financial Safety Net: Implications of a Synthetic Reserve Deposit
authors: Mr. Giovanni Dell
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Sovereigns self-insure via reserve accumulation, prioritizing liquidity over yield. This practice imposes opportunity costs and can amplify the convenience premium on traditional reserve assets. This paper evaluates Synthetic Reserve Deposits (SRDs), a pooling mechanism designed to improve the return-liquidity trade-off. Participants would hold floating-value claims on a vehicle comprising a settlement buffer, an investment portfolio, and, in some designs, an optional collateralized liquidity window. The architecture separates the allocation of portfolio risk from the provision of short-term foreign-currency liquidity: market risk remains with SRD holders, while liquidity is provided through redemption at contemporaneous executable value or through secured advances. Simulations illustrate that the structure can shift the return-liquidity frontier outward under explicit downside-risk constraints. General equilibrium modeling suggests that, if implemented at sufficient scale and under appropriate conditions, reallocating reserve demand through this mechanism could increase the effective supply of reserve claims and affect the global financial cycle, creating aggregate welfare gains and possibly Pareto improvements depending on initial global asset positions.
abstract_zh: 主权国家通过积累外汇储备进行自我保险，优先考虑流动性而非收益。这种做法会产生机会成本，并可能放大传统储备资产的便利溢价。本文评估了合成储备存款（SRDs）这一旨在改善收益-流动性权衡的集合机制。参与者将持有对某一工具的可变价值债权，该工具包含结算缓冲池、投资组合，以及在某些设计中增设的可选抵押流动性窗口。该架构将组合风险配置与短期外币流动性供给相分离：市场风险由SRD持有者承担，流动性则通过按当前可执行价值赎回或通过担保垫款提供。模拟分析表明，在明确的下行风险约束下，该结构可将收益-流动性边界向外推移。一般均衡模型显示，若在适当条件下以足够规模实施，通过该机制重新配置储备需求可增加储备债权的有效供给，影响全球金融周期，产生总体福利收益，并可能根据初始全球资产头寸实现帕累托改进。

title: Household Income Inequality and Optimal Trend Inflation
title_zh: 家庭收入不平等与最优趋势通胀
title_primary: 家庭收入不平等与最优趋势通胀
title_secondary: Household Income Inequality and Optimal Trend Inflation
authors: Jong Soo Kim, Daeha Cho, Kwang Hwan Kim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the optimal inflation target in a tractable heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (THANK) model with an occasionally binding zero lower bound, incorporating income inequality, income risk, and countercyclical fiscal policy. We analytically characterize how cyclical and long-run inequality, income risk, and fiscal policy shape the welfare trade-off of trend inflation across households. Greater cyclical inequality and income risk increase the marginal benefits of inflation, especially for hand-to-mouth (HtM) households, while long-run inequality reduces marginal benefits. Quantitatively, income inequality and income risk modestly raise the utilitarian optimal inflation rate relative to the representative agent benchmark. We further show that countercyclical fiscal policies lower the marginal benefit of inflation for all households and reduce the optimal inflation target. Finally, adding wealth inequality in the form of private or government debt, in addition to income inequality, raises the optimal inflation target.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个具有偶尔约束零下限的可处理异质性代理人新凯恩斯（THANK）模型中，研究了最优通胀目标，该模型纳入了收入不平等、收入风险及逆周期财政政策。我们从理论上刻画了周期性及长期不平等、收入风险与财政政策如何影响跨家庭趋势通胀的福利权衡。更大的周期性不平等和收入风险增加了通胀的边际收益，尤其是对于手到口（HtM）家庭而言，而长期不平等则降低了边际收益。在量化上，相对于代表性代理人基准，收入不平等和收入风险适度提高了功利主义最优通胀率。我们进一步表明，逆周期财政政策降低了所有家庭通胀的边际收益，并减少了最优通胀目标。最后，在收入不平等之外，加入以私人或政府债务形式存在的财富不平等，会提高最优通胀目标。

title: Too Good to Be True: Look-Ahead Bias in Empirical Options Research
title_zh: 过于美好而难以置信：实证期权研究中的前瞻性偏差
title_primary: 过于美好而难以置信：实证期权研究中的前瞻性偏差
title_secondary: Too Good to Be True: Look-Ahead Bias in Empirical Options Research
authors: Jefferson Duarte, Christopher S Jones, Mehdi Khorram, Haitao Mo, Junbo L Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Numerous trading strategies examined in options research exhibit remarkably high mean returns and Sharpe ratios. We show some of these seemingly “good deals” are due to look-ahead biases. These biases stem from using information unavailable at the portfolio formation time to filter out observations suspected of being noisy or erroneous. Our results suggest that elevated Sharpe ratios may serve as potential indicators of such look-ahead biases. Furthermore, deviating from previous literature findings, we show that illiquidity is not strongly priced in stock options and that only a small set of stock characteristics are in fact associated with option expected returns. (JEL G12, G14, G17)
abstract_zh: 摘要 期权研究中检验的众多交易策略呈现出异常高的平均收益率和夏普比率。我们证明，其中一些看似“划算的交易”实际上源于前瞻性偏差。这些偏差产生于使用投资组合构建时无法获取的信息来剔除疑似存在噪声或错误的观测值。研究结果表明，过高的夏普比率可能成为此类前瞻性偏差的潜在预警指标。此外，与既有文献结论不同，我们证实非流动性在股票期权中并未被显著定价，且实际上仅有一小部分股票特征与期权预期收益率存在关联。（JEL分类号：G12, G14, G17）

official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study analyses weekly port calls from 2019 to 2026 to evaluate the Russia–Ukraine war's impact on maritime trade. The data reveals clear structural shifts that Ukrainian traffic moved from high‐risk areas like Odesa to safer Danube River ports. On the other hand, Russia sustained its maritime activity by navigating sanctions and redirecting exports to Asian markets. The Black Sea Grain Initiative also improved navigation conditions for both countries. Overall, the war caused domestic port substitution within Ukraine and a broader logistical reorganization for Russia.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了2019年至2026年的周度港口停靠数据，以评估俄乌战争对海上贸易的影响。数据揭示了明显的结构性转变：乌克兰的航运从敖德萨等高危地区转移至更安全的多瑙河港口。另一方面，俄罗斯通过规避制裁并将出口转向亚洲市场，维持了其海上活动。黑海谷物倡议也改善了两国的航行条件。总体而言，战争导致了乌克兰国内港口的替代效应，并引发了俄罗斯更广泛的物流重组。

title: Do tax cuts ease liquidity constraints?
title_zh: 减税是否缓解了流动性约束？
title_primary: 减税是否缓解了流动性约束？
title_secondary: Do tax cuts ease liquidity constraints?
authors: Richard Acquah-Sarpong, Yong Chen, David Guo, Paul Lewin
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how the Kansas tax experiment, which eliminated state income taxes on pass-through entities between 2012 and 2017, affected firms’ debt payment behavior, a key indicator of liquidity constraint. Using establishment-level data from the National Establishment Time Series (NETS) and exploiting the geographic discontinuity in the Kansas City metropolitan area, we estimate the causal effect of the reform using a spatially anchored difference-in-differences framework. The results show that eliminating pass-through income led to a measurable, but temporary, improvement in the timeliness of debt payments. The average duration of delayed payments was reduced by one-third in the baseline model. The effects were heterogeneous and significant in small and non-publicly listed establishments.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2012年至2017年间堪萨斯州税收实验（该实验取消了穿透实体州所得税）对企业债务支付行为（流动性约束的关键指标）的影响。利用国家企业时间序列数据库（NETS）中的企业层面数据，并借助堪萨斯城都市区的地理断点特征，我们采用空间锚定双重差分框架估计了该改革的因果效应。结果表明，取消穿透实体所得税显著但暂时地改善了债务支付的及时性。在基准模型中，延迟支付的平均时长减少了三分之一。该效应在小型及非上市企业中呈现异质性且更为显著。

title: Competition and Nonprofit’s Strategic Responses: Evidence from Fundraising in Donative Markets
title_zh: 竞争与非营利组织的战略回应：来自捐赠市场筹款的证据
title_primary: 竞争与非营利组织的战略回应：来自捐赠市场筹款的证据
title_secondary: Competition and Nonprofit’s Strategic Responses: Evidence from Fundraising in Donative Markets
authors: Philip G. Gayle, Teresa D. Harrison
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Nonprofit organizations rely on donations from large competitive marketplaces to provide key social service goods. Most research focuses on competition in output markets without considering philanthropic markets where nonprofits make decisions about how much effort to put into fundraising. We develop and estimate a model that highlights the strategic nature of fundraising, showing that rival NP’s fundraising responses can be strategic complements or substitutes. We find evidence of strategic substitutes. NPs demonstrate nontrivial strategic responses to rival’s fundraising and, in totality, the across sector impacts are important to consider. Counterfactual exercises show that reducing competition decreases equilibrium fundraising levels.
abstract_zh: 非营利组织依赖大型竞争性市场的捐赠来提供关键的社会服务产品。现有研究大多关注产出市场的竞争，而未考虑非营利组织在慈善市场中决定投入多少募捐努力的问题。我们构建并估计了一个模型，该模型凸显了募捐的战略性质，表明竞争对手非营利组织的募捐反应可能是战略互补或战略替代的。我们发现了战略替代的证据。非营利组织对竞争对手的募捐表现出不可忽视的战略反应，总体而言，跨部门的影响值得重视。反事实模拟表明，减少竞争会降低均衡募捐水平。

title: Maximal matchings
title_zh: 最大匹配
title_primary: 最大匹配
title_secondary: Maximal matchings
authors: Anh Triêu, Iwan Bos, Marc Schröder, Dries Vermeulen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: There are many situations where policymakers are primarily concerned with the availability and accessibility of goods or services. Examples include electricity, food, housing, medical supplies, et cetera. In such cases, the social goal may be to maximize the number of transactions, which we refer to as a maximal matching. This paper presents a mechanism that implements this objective for markets characterized by bilateral transactions. The mechanism is incentive compatible, but, like the VCG-mechanism that yields the total-utility-maximizing outcome, it requires external funding.
abstract_zh: 在许多情况下，政策制定者主要关注商品或服务的可获得性和可及性。例如电力、食品、住房、医疗用品等。在这些情况下，社会目标可能是最大化交易数量，我们称之为最大匹配。本文提出了一种机制，用于实现以双边交易为特征的市场中的这一目标。该机制具有激励相容性，但与产生总效用最大化结果的VCG机制一样，它需要外部资金支持。
